title: Measurement Conversions: Customary and Metric Units
seo_title: Grade 4 Measurement Conversions Worksheets: Customary and Metric (TEKS 4.8A, 4.8B, STAAR)
standard_text: 4.8A identify relative sizes of measurement units within the customary and metric systems; 4.8B convert measurements within the same measurement system, customary or metric, from a smaller unit into a larger unit or a larger unit into a smaller unit when given other equivalent measures represented in a table
meta_desc: Free Grade 4 measurement worksheets for Texas TEKS 4.8A and 4.8B: sizes of customary and metric units, convert to smaller and larger units, mixed units and conversion tables. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: To a smaller unit: multiply. To a larger unit: divide.
key_sub: 1 foot = 12 inches, 1 yard = 3 feet, 1 pound = 16 ounces, 1 kilogram = 1,000 grams, 1 liter = 1,000 milliliters.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Customary: 1 foot = 12 inches, 1 yard = 3 feet, 1 pound = 16 ounces, 1 gallon = 4 quarts, 1 quart = 2 pints, 1 pint = 2 cups.
  • Metric: 1 meter = 100 centimeters, 1 kilometer = 1,000 meters, 1 kilogram = 1,000 grams, 1 liter = 1,000 milliliters.
  • Larger unit to smaller unit: multiply. Smaller unit to larger unit: divide. A table of equivalent measures helps.

Examples

Example

5 yards = ? feet

1 yard = 3 feet

5 × 3 = 15

Answer: 15 feet

Example

48 ounces = ? pounds

1 pound = 16 ounces

48 ÷ 16 = 3

Answer: 3 pounds

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Dividing when changing to a smaller unitSmaller units mean more of them: multiply.
Using 10 for every conversionCheck the table: 12 inches in a foot, 16 ounces in a pound.
Mixing up feet and yardsA yard is longer: 1 yard = 3 feet.

faq.a: Identify the relative sizes of measurement units within the customary and metric systems.
Convert measurements within the same system from a smaller unit to a larger unit or a larger unit to a smaller unit, using a table of equivalent measures.

faq.q: When do I multiply and when do I divide?
faq.a: Multiply to change to a smaller unit (you need more of them). Divide to change to a larger unit.

faq.q: Do I have to memorize the conversions?
faq.a: On the STAAR Grade 4 test a reference chart is given, but knowing the common ones makes problems faster.

items.q: How long does it take to brush your teeth?
items.e: Brushing your teeth takes about 2 minutes. 2 seconds is far too short, and 2 hours is far too long.

items.q: What is the weight of a loaf of bread?
items.e: A loaf of bread weighs about 1 pound (16 ounces). 1 ounce is about the weight of a slice of bread.

items.q: Which is true?
items.e: 1 pound = 16 ounces, so a pound is heavier than an ounce. The others are backward: 1 ft = 12 in, 1 kg = 1,000 g, and 1 L = 1,000 mL.

items.q: How much water does a small water bottle hold?
items.e: A small water bottle holds about 500 milliliters, which is half of 1 liter. 5 mL is just one spoonful.

items.q: How many inches are in 1 foot?
items.e: 1 ft = 12 in. A 12-inch ruler is exactly 1 foot long.

items.q: You walk for about 15 minutes. About how far do you go?
items.e: In 15 minutes you can walk about 1 kilometer (1,000 m). 1 m is just one big step.

items.q: How many seconds are in 1 minute?
items.e: 1 min = 60 sec (not 100).

items.q: How many grams are in 1 kilogram?
items.e: Kilo means 1,000, so 1 kg = 1,000 g.

items.q: Which list goes from the shortest unit of length to the longest?
items.e: 1 m = 100 cm and 1 km = 1,000 m, so centimeter < meter < kilometer.

items.q: A classroom door is about how tall?
items.e: A door is a little taller than a grown-up, about 2 meters. 2 cm is shorter than your finger, and 2 km is a long walk.

items.q: 1 hour is how many times as long as 1 minute?
items.e: 1 hr = 60 min (not 100), so 1 hour is 60 times as long as 1 minute.

items.q: How many meters are in 1 kilometer?
items.e: Kilo means 1,000, so 1 km = 1,000 m.

items.q: Which list goes from the shortest unit of time to the longest?
items.e: 1 min = 60 sec and 1 hr = 60 min, so second < minute < hour.

items.q: What is the mass of a paper clip?
items.e: A paper clip is very light. Its mass is about 1 gram. 1 kilogram is about the mass of a pineapple.

items.q: Which is greater: 1 hour or 1 minute?
items.e: 1 hour = 60 minutes, so 1 hour is greater.

items.q: Which is greater: 1 gallon or 1 quart?
items.e: 1 gallon = 4 quarts, so 1 gallon is greater.

items.q: Which is greater: 1 foot or 1 inche?
items.e: 1 foot = 12 inches, so 1 foot is greater.

items.q: Which is greater: 1 kilometer or 1 meter?
items.e: 1 kilometer = 1,000 meters, so 1 kilometer is greater.

items.q: Which is greater: 1 minute or 1 second?
items.e: 1 minute = 60 seconds, so 1 minute is greater.

items.q: Which is greater: 1 quart or 1 pint?
items.e: 1 quart = 2 pints, so 1 quart is greater.

items.q: Convert. 4 yd = ☐ ft
items.e: 1 yd = 3 ft. Yards are bigger than feet, so you need more feet: multiply. 4 × 3 = 12, so 4 yd = 12 ft.

items.q: How many inches are in 3 feet?
items.e: 1 ft = 12 in. Feet are bigger than inches, so you need more inches: multiply. 3 × 12 = 36, so 3 ft = 36 in.

items.q: Convert. 4 lb = ☐ oz
items.e: 1 lb = 16 oz. Pounds are bigger than ounces, so you need more ounces: multiply. 4 × 16 = 64, so 4 lb = 64 oz.

items.q: Convert. 5 min = ☐ sec
items.e: 1 min = 60 sec. Minutes are bigger than seconds, so you need more seconds: multiply. 5 × 60 = 300, so 5 min = 300 sec.

items.q: How many milliliters are in 3 liters?
items.e: 1 L = 1,000 mL. Liters are bigger than milliliters, so you need more milliliters: multiply. 3 × 1,000 = 3,000, so 3 L = 3,000 mL.

items.q: Convert. 2 km = ☐ m
items.e: 1 km = 1,000 m. Kilometers are bigger than meters, so you need more meters: multiply. 2 × 1,000 = 2,000, so 2 km = 2,000 m.

items.q: How many minutes are in 4 hours?
items.e: 1 hr = 60 min. Hours are bigger than minutes, so you need more minutes: multiply. 4 × 60 = 240, so 4 hr = 240 min.

items.q: How many days are in 5 weeks?
items.e: 1 week = 7 days. Weeks are bigger than days, so you need more days: multiply. 5 × 7 = 35, so 5 weeks = 35 days.

items.q: Convert. 9 kg = ☐ g
items.e: 1 kg = 1,000 g. Kilograms are bigger than grams, so you need more grams: multiply. 9 × 1,000 = 9,000, so 9 kg = 9,000 g.

items.q: How many centimeters are in 2 meters?
items.e: 1 m = 100 cm. Meters are bigger than centimeters, so you need more centimeters: multiply. 2 × 100 = 200, so 2 m = 200 cm.

items.q: How many grams are in 16 kilograms?
items.e: 1 kg = 1,000 g. Kilograms are bigger than grams, so you need more grams: multiply. 16 × 1,000 = 16,000, so 16 kg = 16,000 g.

items.q: Convert. 30 m = ☐ cm
items.e: 1 m = 100 cm. Meters are bigger than centimeters, so you need more centimeters: multiply. 30 × 100 = 3,000, so 30 m = 3,000 cm.

items.q: How many seconds are in 13 minutes?
items.e: 1 min = 60 sec. Minutes are bigger than seconds, so you need more seconds: multiply. 13 × 60 = 780, so 13 min = 780 sec.

items.q: How many feet are in 22 yards?
items.e: 1 yd = 3 ft. Yards are bigger than feet, so you need more feet: multiply. 22 × 3 = 66, so 22 yd = 66 ft.

items.q: How many ounces are in 7 pounds?
items.e: 1 lb = 16 oz. Pounds are bigger than ounces, so you need more ounces: multiply. 7 × 16 = 112, so 7 lb = 112 oz.

items.q: Convert. 12 hr = ☐ min
items.e: 1 hr = 60 min. Hours are bigger than minutes, so you need more minutes: multiply. 12 × 60 = 720, so 12 hr = 720 min.

items.q: Convert. 19 ft = ☐ in
items.e: 1 ft = 12 in. Feet are bigger than inches, so you need more inches: multiply. 19 × 12 = 228, so 19 ft = 228 in.

items.q: Convert. 7 days = ☐ hr
items.e: 1 day = 24 hr. Days are bigger than hours, so you need more hours: multiply. 7 × 24 = 168, so 7 days = 168 hr.

items.q: How many meters are in 13 kilometers?
items.e: 1 km = 1,000 m. Kilometers are bigger than meters, so you need more meters: multiply. 13 × 1,000 = 13,000, so 13 km = 13,000 m.

items.q: Convert. 19 L = ☐ mL
items.e: 1 L = 1,000 mL. Liters are bigger than milliliters, so you need more milliliters: multiply. 19 × 1,000 = 19,000, so 19 L = 19,000 mL.

items.q: How many feet are in 24 inches?
items.e: 1 foot = 12 inches. 24 ÷ 12 = 2 feet.

items.q: How many weeks are in 35 days?
items.e: 1 week = 7 days. 35 ÷ 7 = 5 weeks.

items.q: How many minutes are in 420 seconds?
items.e: 1 minute = 60 seconds. 420 ÷ 60 = 7 minutes.

items.q: How many meters are in 900 centimeters?
items.e: 1 meter = 100 centimeters. 900 ÷ 100 = 9 meters.

items.q: How many liters are in 6,000 milliliters?
items.e: 1 liter = 1,000 milliliters. 6,000 ÷ 1,000 = 6 liters.

items.q: How many liters are in 2,000 milliliters?
items.e: 1 liter = 1,000 milliliters. 2,000 ÷ 1,000 = 2 liters.

items.q: How many feet are in 108 inches?
items.e: 1 foot = 12 inches. 108 ÷ 12 = 9 feet.

items.q: How many weeks are in 63 days?
items.e: 1 week = 7 days. 63 ÷ 7 = 9 weeks.

items.q: How many yards are in 18 feet?
items.e: 1 yard = 3 feet. 18 ÷ 3 = 6 yards.

items.q: How many liters are in 4,000 milliliters?
items.e: 1 liter = 1,000 milliliters. 4,000 ÷ 1,000 = 4 liters.

items.q: How many weeks are in 49 days?
items.e: 1 week = 7 days. 49 ÷ 7 = 7 weeks.

items.q: How many pounds are in 80 ounces?
items.e: 1 pound = 16 ounces. 80 ÷ 16 = 5 pounds.

items.q: How many liters are in 8,000 milliliters?
items.e: 1 liter = 1,000 milliliters. 8,000 ÷ 1,000 = 8 liters.

items.q: How many quarts are in 10 pints?
items.e: 1 quart = 2 pints. 10 ÷ 2 = 5 quarts.

items.q: How many minutes are in 720 seconds?
items.e: 1 minute = 60 seconds. 720 ÷ 60 = 12 minutes.

items.q: How many gallons are in 36 quarts?
items.e: 1 gallon = 4 quarts. 36 ÷ 4 = 9 gallons.

items.q: How many liters are in 5,000 milliliters?
items.e: 1 liter = 1,000 milliliters. 5,000 ÷ 1,000 = 5 liters.

items.q: How many kilometers are in 9,000 meters?
items.e: 1 kilometer = 1,000 meters. 9,000 ÷ 1,000 = 9 kilometers.

items.q: How many kilometers are in 5,000 meters?
items.e: 1 kilometer = 1,000 meters. 5,000 ÷ 1,000 = 5 kilometers.

items.q: How many meters are in 400 centimeters?
items.e: 1 meter = 100 centimeters. 400 ÷ 100 = 4 meters.

items.q: Convert. 4 kg 250 g = ☐ g
items.e: Change the kilograms first: 4 × 1,000 = 4,000 g. Then add the leftover grams: 4,000 + 250 = 4,250 g.

items.q: Convert. 2 kg 50 g = ☐ g
items.e: Change the kilograms first: 2 × 1,000 = 2,000 g. Then add the leftover grams: 2,000 + 50 = 2,050 g.

items.q: Convert. 4 m 8 cm = ☐ cm
items.e: Change the meters first: 4 × 100 = 400 cm. Then add the leftover centimeters: 400 + 8 = 408 cm.

items.q: Convert. 2 ft 5 in = ☐ in
items.e: Change the feet first: 2 × 12 = 24 in. Then add the leftover inches: 24 + 5 = 29 in.

items.q: Convert. 3 hr 20 min = ☐ min
items.e: Change the hours first: 3 × 60 = 180 min. Then add the leftover minutes: 180 + 20 = 200 min.

items.q: Convert. 4 min 15 sec = ☐ sec
items.e: Change the minutes first: 4 × 60 = 240 sec. Then add the leftover seconds: 240 + 15 = 255 sec.

items.q: Convert. 5 km 300 m = ☐ m
items.e: Change the kilometers first: 5 × 1,000 = 5,000 m. Then add the leftover meters: 5,000 + 300 = 5,300 m.

items.q: Convert. 2 L 750 mL = ☐ mL
items.e: Change the liters first: 2 × 1,000 = 2,000 mL. Then add the leftover milliliters: 2,000 + 750 = 2,750 mL.

items.q: Convert. 2 lb 7 oz = ☐ oz
items.e: Change the pounds first: 2 × 16 = 32 oz. Then add the leftover ounces: 32 + 7 = 39 oz.

items.q: Convert. 3 yd 2 ft = ☐ ft
items.e: Change the yards first: 3 × 3 = 9 ft. Then add the leftover feet: 9 + 2 = 11 ft.

items.q: Which is the longest?
items.e: Change everything to inches: 5 ft = 60 in and 1 yd 1 ft = 3 ft + 1 ft = 48 in. In order: 60 in, 58 in, 55 in, 48 in. So the answer is 5 ft.

items.q: Which is the heaviest?
items.e: Change everything to grams: 2 kg = 2,000 g and 2 kg 75 g = 2,075 g. In order: 2,075 g, 2,070 g, 2,000 g, 1,950 g. So the answer is 2 kg 75 g.

items.q: 7 wk 6 d = ? days
items.e: 7 weeks = 7 × 7 = 49 days. Add 6: 55 days.

items.q: 8 h 3 min = ? minutes
items.e: 8 hours = 8 × 60 = 480 minutes. Add 3: 483 minutes.

items.q: 5 wk 5 d = ? days
items.e: 5 weeks = 5 × 7 = 35 days. Add 5: 40 days.

items.q: 4 gal 1 qt = ? quarts
items.e: 4 gallons = 4 × 4 = 16 quarts. Add 1: 17 quarts.

items.q: 3 h 34 min = ? minutes
items.e: 3 hours = 3 × 60 = 180 minutes. Add 34: 214 minutes.

items.q: 8 lb 15 oz = ? ounces
items.e: 8 pounds = 8 × 16 = 128 ounces. Add 15: 143 ounces.

items.q: 6 min 5 s = ? seconds
items.e: 6 minutes = 6 × 60 = 360 seconds. Add 5: 365 seconds.

items.q: 4 gal 3 qt = ? quarts
items.e: 4 gallons = 4 × 4 = 16 quarts. Add 3: 19 quarts.

items.q: Which row could be added to this table?
items.e: 1 hr = 60 min, so the right number is always the left number × 60. 11 × 60 = 660, so 11 hr = 660 min fits.

items.q: Which row could be added to this table?
items.e: 1 ft = 12 in, so the right number is always the left number × 12. 8 × 12 = 96, so 8 ft = 96 in fits.

items.q: Which rule changes the left column into the right column?
items.e: 1 lb = 16 oz. Each left number times 16 gives the right number, for example 4 × 16 = 64. Adding 16 does not work: 4 + 16 = 20, not 64.

items.q: What number goes in the ? box?
items.e: 1 week = 7 days, so every number on the right is the left number × 7. 8 × 7 = 56.

items.q: What number goes in the ? box?
items.e: 1 min = 60 sec, so every number on the right is the left number × 60. 9 × 60 = 540.

items.q: What number goes in the ? box?
items.e: 1 kg = 1,000 g, so every number on the right is the left number × 1,000. 8 × 1,000 = 8,000.

items.q: Which row could be added to this table?
items.e: 1 m = 100 cm, so the right number is always the left number × 100. 9 × 100 = 900, so 9 m = 900 cm fits.

items.q: What number goes in the ? box?
items.e: Each row follows the rule 1 day = 24 hr. Go backward: how many days make 216 hr? 216 ÷ 24 = 9. Check: 9 × 24 = 216.

items.q: What number goes in the ? box?
items.e: Each row follows the rule 1 m = 100 cm. Go backward: how many meters make 600 cm? 600 ÷ 100 = 6. Check: 6 × 100 = 600.

items.q: What number goes in the ? box?
items.e: 1 lb = 16 oz, so every number on the right is the left number × 16. 7 × 16 = 112.

items.q: Which rule changes the left column into the right column?
items.e: 1 kg = 1,000 g. Each left number times 1,000 gives the right number, for example 4 × 1,000 = 4,000. Adding 1,000 does not work: 4 + 1,000 = 1,004, not 4,000.

items.q: What number goes in the ? box?
items.e: 1 L = 1,000 mL, so every number on the right is the left number × 1,000. 7 × 1,000 = 7,000.

items.q: What number goes in the ? box?
items.e: 1 ft = 12 in, so every number on the right is the left number × 12. 7 × 12 = 84.

items.q: What number goes in the ? box?
items.e: 1 lb = 16 oz, so every number on the right is the left number × 16. 8 × 16 = 128.

items.q: Which rule changes the left column into the right column?
items.e: 1 min = 60 sec. Each left number times 60 gives the right number, for example 5 × 60 = 300. Adding 60 does not work: 5 + 60 = 65, not 300.

items.q: What number goes in the ? box?
items.e: 1 hr = 60 min, so every number on the right is the left number × 60. 4 × 60 = 240.

items.q: Which rule changes the left column into the right column?
items.e: 1 yd = 3 ft. Each left number times 3 gives the right number, for example 5 × 3 = 15. Adding 3 does not work: 5 + 3 = 8, not 15.

items.q: What number goes in the ? box?
items.e: 1 km = 1,000 m, so every number on the right is the left number × 1,000. 5 × 1,000 = 5,000.

items.q: What number goes in the ? box?
items.e: 1 yd = 3 ft, so every number on the right is the left number × 3. 9 × 3 = 27.

items.q: Which row could be added to this table?
items.e: 1 L = 1,000 mL, so the right number is always the left number × 1,000. 8 × 1,000 = 8,000, so 8 L = 8,000 mL fits.
